title: Guided Listening: HAW 101
description: Begin training your ear with an official University of Hawaiʻi at Hilo Hawaiian-language learning recording.

sourceReview.notes: The audio source and speaker attribution were verified on the official Ka Haka ʻUla O Keʻelikōlani HAW 101 podcast page. This lesson treats the recording as guided exposure only; it does not claim mastery or provide an invented transcript.

activities.instruction: Listen before trying to analyze every word.
activities.support: This is listening exposure, not a quiz. Your goal is to become more comfortable hearing Hawaiian spoken by a trusted source.
activities.audioSourceName: Ka Haka ʻUla O Keʻelikōlani — HAW 101
listeningNotes: Listen for the overall rhythm before worrying about individual words.
Notice pauses and changes in vowel length as you hear them.
Replay sections when something catches your ear. You do not need to understand everything yet.
